name: TechRing
description: SDR workspace images for Kasm Workspaces.

workspaces.description: Aviation RF decoders: ADS-B (dump1090), ACARS (acarsdec), VDL2 (dumpvdl2), HFDL (dumphfdl), and airband scanner (rtl_airband).
workspaces.notes:
Aviation-focused decoders for ADS-B, ACARS, VDL2, HFDL, and VHF airband. Includes GNU Radio 3.10 + OOT modules in the base.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.

workspaces.description: Cellular network analysis: srsRAN 4G/5G, LTESniffer, FALCON, LTE Cell Scanner, Osmocom GSM stack, and kalibrate-hackrf.
workspaces.notes:
Cellular analysis tools for GSM/LTE/5G. srsRAN provides eNodeB and UE simulation. LTESniffer and FALCON for passive LTE analysis. Osmocom for GSM.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.

workspaces.description: Ham radio digital modes and broadcast decoders: fldigi, WSJT-X, Direwolf, JS8Call, M17, HD Radio (nrsc5), and DAB/DAB+ (qt-dab).
workspaces.notes:
Digital mode applications for amateur radio and broadcast reception. Includes GNU Radio 3.10 + OOT modules in the base.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.

workspaces.description: RF protocol analysis and reverse engineering: rtl_433 (ISM band), multimon-ng (multi-protocol), inspectrum (spectrogram), URH (Universal Radio Hacker), and ubertooth (Bluetooth).
workspaces.notes:
Lightweight protocol analysis workspace for ISM band, Bluetooth, and RF reverse engineering. Includes GNU Radio 3.10 + OOT modules in the base.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.

workspaces.description: Satellite reception and tracking: SatDump (weather/comms satellites), Gpredict (tracking), noaa-apt (NOAA APT decoder), and iridium-toolkit.
workspaces.notes:
Satellite reception, decoding, and tracking tools. gr-satellites OOT module included in base for GNU Radio satellite flowgraphs.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.

workspaces.description: GUI SDR receiver applications: GQRX, SDR++, SDRAngel, CubicSDR, SigDigger, plus GNU Radio Companion for flowgraph development.
workspaces.notes:
GUI SDR receivers with desktop launchers. Includes GNU Radio 3.10 + 30 OOT modules in the base.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.

workspaces.description: Complete SDR development and analysis environment with GNU Radio 3.10, 30+ OOT modules, SDR drivers, GUI apps (GQRX, SDR++, SDRAngel, CubicSDR, SatDump, SigDigger), decoders, cellular tools, digital modes, and trunking.
workspaces.notes:
Based on kasmweb/core-ubuntu-noble:1.18.0. The kitchen-sink image with every SDR tool. For focused workspaces, see DragonOS - SDR Receivers, Aviation, Cellular, etc.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.
